checks.expected: the opening at its first step
Esc: the end state (04:00, Study, ½×, Play focused, the bar hidden, the dispatch shown)
begun again: the same first step
a press on the map ends the opening where it is: stopped, ½× back, the bar hidden, the dispatch back
begun again after the press: first step, its clock
a key ends it in place and does its own action (Watch); speed back; focus on a visible control
a drag ends the opening where it is (camera taken), Follow off
? opens over the opening; the first Esc closes the overlay only; the second skips to the start
the tour at stop 1, the dispatch hidden
the tour steps on in Watch
Esc ends the tour: the bar hidden, the dispatch back
begun again: stop 1 at its clock
the paper map is not at the eye level
after the ways back, every reading of the state as on a fresh page (the clock aside)
